scope: Standard textured minimap repair through reusable public MCP, console protocol, and one native point-effect presentation failure with controlled damage observations.

supersedes.scope: Its gray ModKit image rendered, but the user rejected it as final minimap appearance. That historical observation does not establish standard textured minimap acceptance.

minimap.renderer: Original SC2 Editor full-map terrain export

frame.review: Actual terrain textures, both cliff shapes, unit dots and camera rectangle are visible. The gray/white draft overview is replaced.

minimap.vision: Only Minimap.tga changed in the rebuild transaction. Existing map reveal/fog logic was preserved; no additional vision or fog override was added. This fixture already reveals the map and does not prove every fog transition or rectangular-map mapping.
guards: Component/dependency and archive revision checks before staging and save

baseline.observation: Ability/damage occurred without the triangle visual actors.

pointEffect.fix: Remove At Target from the point-search effect Start event and use SOpShadow. Original native Actor Data read confirmed the inherited animation bracket; its event merge was not rewritten.
pointEffect.mapAuthoring: Public data.batch strict transaction:5 field/event changes; no direct component writer.

nativeRuns.review: Rendered triangular lattice reviewed in actual game frames. Individual cells animate and fade; no synthetic media.

pointEffect.controlInterpretation: With caster at56,58 and target60,70, all three in-pattern targets lost life. Negative controls at78,64 and68,50 were unchanged. Multiple overlapping cells may each deal40 damage. Earlier controls at67/70 north of a60,64 cast were outside the caster-relative pattern, not evidence that offsets failed.
pointEffect.mcpPrevention: data.presentation.check now reports explicit TargetPoint/At Target event-scope combinations for review. This is not a blanket ban on unit-target actor scope.

backModule.change: Create LabBackModule from the main unit ActorCreation and host on _Selectable; preserve the existing main unit animation handlers.
backModule.review: Two native close-ups reviewed; the small mechanical back attachment is visible. Full firing/rotation/death lifecycle acceptance is not claimed.

diagnostics.protocol: Read game diagnostics after launch and tested actions; follow continuations and read original owned Editor Messages/Console.
diagnostics.coverage: Game actor/model/Galaxy sources remain partial. Empty partial logs do not prove all subsystems clear. Recording also collected incremental diagnostics.
diagnostics.editor: Original retained Messages/Console read completed with no new errors/warnings. A prior Data inspection baseline contained a missing stock PhotonCannon icon image; it was not reclassified as a new ability/model error.

staticVerification.tests: 20 final focused minimap, ModKit and presentation tests passed.
staticVerification.build: Final TypeScript build, release build, English documentation check and verification-evidence integrity check passed.
staticVerification.limits: Does not certify every map, model, hotkey, sound, fog transition, water profile or UI browser playback.
